content.hebrew: אֶ֒שָֹּא בְּכוֹס יֶשַׁע : וּבְשֵׁם אָדוֹן אֶקְרָא
content.transliteration: Essa bechos yesha‘ : Uvshem adon eḳra
content.english: I shall raise the cup of deliverance and invoke the name of the Lord

content.hebrew: נַבְדִּיל לְבֵין שַׁבָּת : בֵּין חֹל לְיָמֵינוּ:
content.transliteration: Navdil leven shabbat : Ben ḥol leyamenu.
content.english: We shall distinguish between the Sabbath and the profane, all our days.

content.hebrew: בָּ֒אוּ יְמֵי הַחֹל : הַצְלַח לְכָל עֹבֵד
content.english: The profane days have arrived; make all that serve [You] succeed!
Your ways are lofty; none among us understands them.

content.hebrew: ה֒וֹדְךָ וְ֒עֹז יָדְךָ : מִי הוּא אֲשֶׁר יַשְֹכִּיל
content.transliteration: Hodecha ve‘oz yadecha : Mi hu asher yaskil
content.english: Your splendor and mighty hand, who could understand them?
The radiant light of Your words are dim in our eyes!
Its scholars? Aren’t they gone? They flew to their nests!
Those who know are in their graves; may this be a sign to our eyes.

content.hebrew: כָּ֒מַהּ וְגַם תָּמַהּ : נַפְשִׁי עֲלֵי כָל זֶה
content.transliteration: Kamah veḡam tamah : Nafshi ‘alé chol zé
content.english: My soul is aching and amazed by it all:

content.hebrew: לִ֒רְאוֹת בְּצָרָה זוֹ : אֵין דֵּי לְרוּחֵנוּ:
content.transliteration: Lirot betsara zo : En dé leruḥenu.
content.english: Seeing this predicament is not enough for our spirits.
What will I say, my God? Display Your mercies,
Please, purge us from those things that suppress our minds.
The revenge of Your servants—avenge it with Your wrath;
Send Your love between each of us and our brethren.
The bearers of the yoke of Your Law yearn like harts.
Relieve their servitude; Destroy our oppressors.
Release their restraints; let them contemplate your Torah
And forever enjoy the love of our Lord.
Command your emissaries, the ones fulfilling your words.
May they bless us, all of our deeds!
Remove our jealousy of any man;
Annul the jealousy of those who rise against us.
Be exalted through Your strength; turn away from Your anger;
Build the Temple, soon, in our times.
Remember Your chosen ones, the first among Your creatures.
We pine for Your words, in all our thoughts.

content.hebrew: בִּ֒ינָ֒ה הֲגִיג הַדַּל : נִגְרָשׁ וְגַם נִבְדָּל
content.transliteration: Bina haḡiḡ haddal : Niḡrash veḡam nivdal
content.english: Consider the lament of the deprived, the expelled, the divided,
The troubled and impoverished amidst our congregation.

content.hebrew: נַ֒חֵם תְּ֒נַחֵם נָ֒א : בּוֹכִים בְּמַר גָּלוּת
content.transliteration: Naḥem tenaḥem na : Bochim bemar galut
content.english: Please, console those who weep in the bitter exile.

content.hebrew: זֻלּוּת וְגַם דַּלּוּת : עוֹד לֹא יְאֻנֵּנוּ:
content.english: Worthlessness and poverty shall no longer befall us!

content.hebrew: ח֒וּשָׁה זְ֒מַן קֹ֒דֶשׁ : שַׁבָּת וְיוֹם אָרוּךְ
content.transliteration: Ḥusha zeman ḳodesh : Shabbat veyom aruch
content.english: Hasten the sacred time, the Sabbath, and the eternal day.

content.hebrew: נַבְדִּיל לְבֵין קֹדֶשׁ : בֵּין חֹל לְיָמֵינוּ:
content.transliteration: Navdil leven ḳodesh : Ben ḥol leyamenu.
content.english: We shall distinguish between the sacred and the profane in our days.

content.hebrew: כַּכָּתוּב וּֽלֲהַבְדִּ֔יל בֵּ֥ין הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ וּבֵ֣ין הַחֹ֑ל (ויקרא י, י)
content.transliteration: Kakkatuv: Ulhavdil ben haḳḳodesh uven haḥol.
content.english: As it is written: For you must distinguish between the sacred and the profane (Lev. 10:10).
